From 78a81d88f60ba773cbe890205e1ee67f00502948 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Joerg Roedel <jroedel@suse.de>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2021 15:17:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] x86/sev-es: Introduce ip_within_syscall_gap() helper

Introduce a helper to check whether an exception came from the syscall
gap and use it in the SEV-ES code. Extend the check to also cover the
compatibility SYSCALL entry path.

Fixes: 315562c9af3d5 ("x86/sev-es: Adjust #VC IST Stack on entering NMI handler")
Signed-off-by: Joerg Roedel <jroedel@suse.de>
Signed-off-by: Borislav Petkov <bp@suse.de>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # 5.10+
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20210303141716.29223-2-joro@8bytes.org

diff --git a/arch/x86/kernel/traps.c b/arch/x86/kernel/traps.c
index 7f5aec758f0e..ac1874a2a70e 100644
--- a/arch/x86/kernel/traps.c
+++ b/arch/x86/kernel/traps.c
@@ -694,8 +694,7 @@ asmlinkage __visible noinstr struct pt_regs *vc_switch_off_ist(struct pt_regs *r
 	 * In the SYSCALL entry path the RSP value comes from user-space - don't
 	 * trust it and switch to the current kernel stack
 	 */
-	if (regs->ip >= (unsigned long)entry_SYSCALL_64 &&
-	    regs->ip <  (unsigned long)entry_SYSCALL_64_safe_stack) {
+	if (ip_within_syscall_gap(regs)) {
 		sp = this_cpu_read(cpu_current_top_of_stack);
 		goto sync;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/arch/x86/include/asm/proto.h b/arch/x86/include/asm/proto.h
index 2c35f1c01a2d..b6a9d51d1d79 100644
--- a/arch/x86/include/asm/proto.h
+++ b/arch/x86/include/asm/proto.h
@@ -25,6 +25,7 @@ void __end_SYSENTER_singlestep_region(void);
 void entry_SYSENTER_compat(void);
 void __end_entry_SYSENTER_compat(void);
 void entry_SYSCALL_compat(void);
+void entry_SYSCALL_compat_safe_stack(void);
 void entry_INT80_compat(void);
 #ifdef CONFIG_XEN_PV
 void xen_entry_INT80_compat(void);

diff --git a/arch/x86/include/asm/ptrace.h b/arch/x86/include/asm/ptrace.h
index d8324a236696..409f661481e1 100644
--- a/arch/x86/include/asm/ptrace.h
+++ b/arch/x86/include/asm/ptrace.h
@@ -94,6 +94,8 @@ struct pt_regs {
 #include <asm/paravirt_types.h>
 #endif
 
+#include <asm/proto.h>
+
 struct cpuinfo_x86;
 struct task_struct;
 
@@ -175,6 +177,19 @@ static inline bool any_64bit_mode(struct pt_regs *regs)
 #ifdef CONFIG_X86_64
 #define current_user_stack_pointer()	current_pt_regs()->sp
 #define compat_user_stack_pointer()	current_pt_regs()->sp
+
+static inline bool ip_within_syscall_gap(struct pt_regs *regs)
+{
+	bool ret = (regs->ip >= (unsigned long)entry_SYSCALL_64 &&
+		    regs->ip <  (unsigned long)entry_SYSCALL_64_safe_stack);
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_IA32_EMULATION
+	ret = ret || (regs->ip >= (unsigned long)entry_SYSCALL_compat &&
+		      regs->ip <  (unsigned long)entry_SYSCALL_compat_safe_stack);
+#endif
+
+	return ret;
+}
 #endif
 
 static inline unsigned long kernel_stack_pointer(struct pt_regs *regs)

diff --git a/arch/x86/entry/entry_64_compat.S b/arch/x86/entry/entry_64_compat.S
index 541fdaf64045..0051cf5c792d 100644
--- a/arch/x86/entry/entry_64_compat.S
+++ b/arch/x86/entry/entry_64_compat.S
@@ -210,6 +210,8 @@ SYM_CODE_START(entry_SYSCALL_compat)
 	/* Switch to the kernel stack */
 	movq	PER_CPU_VAR(cpu_current_top_of_stack), %rsp
 
+SYM_INNER_LABEL(entry_SYSCALL_compat_safe_stack, SYM_L_GLOBAL)
+
 	/* Construct struct pt_regs on stack */
 	pushq	$__USER32_DS		/* pt_regs->ss */
 	pushq	%r8			/* pt_regs->sp */

### Modifications in Each File

1. **`arch/x86/kernel/traps.c`**
   - Introduced a new helper function `ip_within_syscall_gap()` to check if an instruction pointer (IP) is within the syscall gap.
   - Replaced the existing conditional check for the IP in the SYSCALL entry path with a call to the new helper function.

2. **`arch/x86/include/asm/proto.h`**
   - Added a prototype declaration for the new function `entry_SYSCALL_compat_safe_stack()`.

3. **`arch/x86/include/asm/ptrace.h`**
   - Included the header for prototypes to access the new helper function.
   - Defined the `ip_within_syscall_gap()` function, which checks if the IP is within the syscall gap for both 64-bit and compatibility syscall entry paths.

4. **`arch/x86/entry/entry_64_compat.S`**
   - Added a label for `entry_SYSCALL_compat_safe_stack` to support the new syscall gap checking mechanism.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The introduction of the `ip_within_syscall_gap()` function in `ptrace.h` centralizes the logic for checking if an IP is within the syscall gap, which enhances code readability and maintainability.
- The changes in `traps.c` utilize this new helper function, replacing the previous inline check, thereby reducing code duplication and potential errors.
- The addition of the `entry_SYSCALL_compat_safe_stack` label in `entry_64_compat.S` is related to the new helper function, as it provides the necessary boundary for the compatibility syscall checks.
- The prototype declaration in `proto.h` ensures that the new function is accessible across the relevant files, maintaining proper linkage and function visibility. 

Overall, these modifications work together to improve the handling of syscall gaps in the SEV-ES code, ensuring that both standard and compatibility syscall paths are correctly managed.
